SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN payment_attempts a ON t.attempt_id=a.attempt_id
        WHERE a.attempt_id IS NULL OR a.status!='success' OR t.date!=a.date OR t.user_id!=a.user_id
        OR t.streamer_id!=a.streamer_id OR t.amount_idr!=a.amount_idr

SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM payment_attempts a LEFT JOIN transactions t ON a.attempt_id=t.attempt_id
        WHERE a.status='success' AND t.transaction_id IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM transactions t WHERE NOT EXISTS
        (SELECT 1 FROM view_sessions v WHERE v.date=t.date AND v.user_id=t.user_id AND v.streamer_id=t.streamer_id)

SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM payment_attempts WHERE status IS NULL OR status NOT IN ('success','failed')
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM users WHERE platform IS NULL OR platform NOT IN ('Android','iOS') OR channel IS NULL OR channel NOT IN ('organic','ads','referral') OR device_id IS NULL OR length(device_id)=0
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM streamers WHERE tier IS NULL OR tier NOT IN ('head','mid','tail')
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM view_sessions WHERE duration_seconds IS NULL OR duration_seconds<0

WITH 
user_day AS (
 SELECT t.date,t.user_id,u.device_id,COUNT(*) n,SUM(t.amount_idr) gmv
 FROM transactions t JOIN users u ON u.user_id=t.user_id
 WHERE t.date BETWEEN :start AND :end GROUP BY t.date,t.user_id,u.device_id
), device_day AS (
 SELECT date,device_id,COUNT(*) payers FROM user_day GROUP BY date,device_id
), risk AS (
 SELECT p.date,p.user_id FROM user_day p JOIN device_day d
 ON p.date=d.date AND p.device_id=d.device_id
 WHERE p.n>=5 AND p.gmv>=2000000 AND d.payers>=3
)
,
    views AS (
      SELECT v.date,'all' dimension,COUNT(DISTINCT v.user_id) active_uv
      FROM view_sessions v JOIN users u ON u.user_id=v.user_id JOIN streamers s ON s.streamer_id=v.streamer_id
      WHERE v.date BETWEEN :start AND :end  GROUP BY v.date,dimension
    ), attempts AS (
      SELECT a.date,'all' dimension,COUNT(*) attempts,SUM(a.status='success') successes
      FROM payment_attempts a JOIN users u ON u.user_id=a.user_id JOIN streamers s ON s.streamer_id=a.streamer_id
      WHERE a.date BETWEEN :start AND :end  GROUP BY a.date,dimension
    ), revenue AS (
      SELECT t.date,'all' dimension,COUNT(DISTINCT t.user_id) paying_uv,SUM(t.amount_idr) gross_gmv_idr,
      SUM(CASE WHEN r.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.amount_idr ELSE 0 END) suspicious_gmv_idr
      FROM transactions t JOIN users u ON u.user_id=t.user_id JOIN streamers s ON s.streamer_id=t.streamer_id
      LEFT JOIN risk r ON r.date=t.date AND r.user_id=t.user_id
      WHERE t.date BETWEEN :start AND :end  GROUP BY t.date,dimension
    ), keys AS (
      SELECT date,dimension FROM views UNION SELECT date,dimension FROM attempts UNION SELECT date,dimension FROM revenue
    ) SELECT k.date,k.dimension,COALESCE(v.active_uv,0) active_uv,COALESCE(a.attempts,0) attempts,
      COALESCE(a.successes,0) successes,COALESCE(t.paying_uv,0) paying_uv,
      COALESCE(t.gross_gmv_idr,0) gross_gmv_idr,COALESCE(t.suspicious_gmv_idr,0) suspicious_gmv_idr
      FROM keys k LEFT JOIN views v ON k.date=v.date AND k.dimension=v.dimension
      LEFT JOIN attempts a ON k.date=a.date AND k.dimension=a.dimension
      LEFT JOIN revenue t ON k.date=t.date AND k.dimension=t.dimension ORDER BY k.date,k.dimension
